text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: How'd you like that?! Looks like our desires were bigger than you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見たかにゃー！　
あたしたちの欲望の勝利にゃー！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
We really did it, Tamaki!
Whew... Finally, our strange ordeal is over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったわね、タマキさん！
ふう、
これで全て終わったのね……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃにゃにゃ！？　
ミフユ、
向こうを見るにゃ！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Another island just surfaced...
Could it be another Island Whale?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？　
別の島が出てきた……
もしかしてあれも島クジラ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I don't knyow, but there's only one way to find out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わからにゃいけど、
こうなったら徹底的に調べてやるにゃ！
